_comment: Copy this file to deploy/vendor-secrets.json (already gitignored, never commit the copy), fill in the real values below, and pass -VendorSecretsPath to Provision-FullStack.ps1. These are the only values that script cannot generate or discover itself — everything else (DB service login, JWT signing key, shared API key, initial admin password) is generated fresh at provisioning time.

Upstream.BaseUrl: <the real NIA selfie-verification base URL, e.g. https://selfie.imsgh.org:2035/skyface>
Upstream.ApiKey: <real upstream API key, if AuthType is ApiKey or Bearer>

Selfie.UserId: <real userID this merchant should present to NIA>

CreditApi.BaseUrl: <real XDS credit API base URL, e.g. https://www.online.xdsdata.com/XdsDataRestApi>
